description: The man the message goes to. Not in the house.
name: Ambrose Kettleby

description: Told it again, and kept the Theatre unswearable by name.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Separated the letter's words from the clerk's, and gave a mayor six weeks in the chain.
name: George Bryan

description: Went purple over eighty-four, and did not march on Crosby Place.
name: James Burbage

description: Sends tonight. The leaf is yours.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept Thursday fortnight, and said he would play the king in the street if they are shut on the first of October.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Said tour, and was not agreed with.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.
name: William Shakespeare
